text.p: Shares in Placer Dome Inc and Crystallex International Corp were actively traded and weaker Thursday after a Venezuelan court ruling on the disputed Las Cristinas gold property.
Placer stock was 0.05 lower at 23.00 after earlier falling to 22.20 in Toronto. Crystallex stock fell 0.22 to 3.79 after trading in a range of 3.55 to 4.30. Both stocks moved on heavy volume.
Traders said there was widespread confusion after the two companies gave opposing interpretations to a ruling by the Supreme Court of Venezuela.
Placer said the decision had no bearing on its tenure at Las Cristinas where it hopes to begin building a gold mine next month.
Crystallex, which has laid claim to two blocks of the property, said the Venezuelan court decision "reaffirms Crystallex's position as to the validity of its ownership rights" of the blocks.
Placer said the court ordered publication of its current ruling and rulings in 1991 and 1996 dealing with transfer of the Las Cristinas blocks. It said the decisions did not affect its rights.
Crystallex gave a vastly different interpretation. It said the court order this week that the rulings be published would be the final legal formality required for its claim to be validated.
